title: 第二十一章 伊图爱丝娜生命牧师第二十二章 过去的一些回忆
content_zh:
铂鹰旗南带领商队启程向古羽镇方向出发，而颜铁龙赶着马车紧随其后跟着商队。
“鸪图莉琦，你认识那个昏迷不醒的家伙吗？”颜铁龙一边赶着马车一边对马车里的鸪图莉琦询问认不认识被自己打晕并绑起来的年轻人。
“认识！他就是一个坏蛋！”鸪图莉琦直接承认并带着厌恶的语气道。
“哦！那你能跟我说说他叫什么，在毒狼帮又干什么？”颜铁龙听到鸪图莉琦认识并带着一些厌恶就询问年轻人事。
“他叫符罗图恩，在我们圈子里的人都喜欢称呼他为刺狗，他是毒狼帮帮主最信任的狗头军师鹰库安斯的红牌打手。
符罗图恩以前跟我们一样都是以乞讨为生活的乞丐，在他没有加入独狼帮之时，强然喜欢捣乱和捉弄人，是总体来说算是一个好人，那时他会常常跟欺负我们那些坏人打架。
可是自从他加入毒狼帮变了，只要鹰库安斯吩咐的事，他不管这件事是对还是错，都会拼命的去完成，而且一点也不念旧情。
我以前亲眼看到他亲手把他十分要好的朋友打成重伤，后来我就没有在铂斯特罗要塞看到他那位十分要好的朋友过，从那以后，我们都躲着他。”鸪图莉琦神情有点复杂的介绍符罗图恩人品，以及一些往事。
“看来这位叫符罗图恩年轻人应该跟鹰库安斯之间发生了什么事？才会让符罗图恩对鹰库安斯那么忠诚了。”颜铁龙听到鸪图莉琦对符罗图恩的事迹就猜测道。
“大哥哥，我们也是这样想的，以前也人打听过符罗图恩跟鹰库安斯自建的事情，可惜都没有什么结果。”鸪图莉琦有些无奈的说道。
“呵呵，这下倒是有意思，我要看看欧斯派恩，他是怎么样让符罗图恩弃恶从善，现在想想真是让人期待呀。”颜铁龙内心乐呵呵地想到道，然后他认真的赶着马车。
旁晚，铂鹰旗南商队跟颜铁龙马车，有惊无险的安全到达古羽镇，在几天，他们没有遇到绿皮以及不法分子。
在绿羽茜酒馆门口，正在等待颜铁龙他们到来的克米迪斯，他看着完好的姆鲁兽车队就对坐在马车上颜铁龙问道：“铁龙，这一次护卫任务没有发生什么事吗？”。
“这一次护卫任务发生了很多事，只不过对商队来说，并没有什么事。”颜铁龙回应道。
“哦，那还等什么，走跟我一起喝几杯，在告诉我都发生了什么事？”克米迪斯听到颜铁龙的话感兴趣道。
“抱歉，克米迪斯大叔，我准备了一些东西，还要去一个地方。
至于这一次护卫任务发生的事，等明天或者让铂鹰旗南他来告诉你，你觉得怎么样？”颜铁龙对克米迪斯抱歉并提议道。
“恩～，原来是这样，那好吧，铁龙替我跟那位女士问好。”克米迪斯听到颜铁龙的话，同时他看到颜铁龙的马车就恍然大悟道。
“好的，克米迪斯大叔我知道了。”颜铁龙点头回应道。
颜铁龙对下姆鲁兽车的欧斯派恩说道：“欧斯派恩上来吧，我顺便带你去见上一次我所说的那位女士。”。

欧斯派恩听到颜铁龙要介绍上一次让他感觉十分完美的女士就同意道：“颜铁龙团长，好的，我就上来。”。
颜铁龙在欧斯派恩上了马车后，他就赶着马车向另一个地方赶去。
“吁～！到了，鸪图莉琦，鸪图莉雪，欧斯派恩你们可以下车了。”颜铁龙将马车赶到有点陈旧同时让人感觉朴素的西方小型教堂面前，他转过身对马车里的人道。
“是，是铁龙哥哥！”“牧师妈妈快出来呀！铁龙哥哥回来了！”小型教堂走出一名穿着补丁布衣的六七岁小男孩，他拿着扫把正准备扫教堂面前道路，当他就看到马车上的颜铁龙吃惊道，然后拿着扫把转身跑进教堂，他以激动的声音大声喊道。
“颜铁龙团长，这里是？”欧斯派恩看到颜铁龙将鸪图二姐妹抱下马车就询问小教堂道。
“哦，这里是丝羽黎生命教堂，据说这座教堂跟古羽镇一样悠久，也是小镇唯一的教堂。”颜铁龙向欧斯派恩和自己身边的鸪图二姐妹介绍道。
“铁龙哥哥”“铁龙哥哥，我好想你！”。当颜铁龙刚介绍完，生命教堂跑出八九名大小不一穿着补丁的小萝莉和小萝卜头，他们一边跑一边激动的叫着颜铁龙的名字。
“呵呵，小熊包，你长大了，也变重啦。”颜铁龙抱起第一位到他身边的大概七岁穿着六个大补丁的布衣的小男孩微笑道。
“铁龙哥哥，我要抱抱。”一位六岁，梳着双尾辫子同样有十几个小布丁小女孩伸出双手道。
content_en:
Boying Qinan led the caravan to set off towards Guyu Town, while Yan Tielong drove the carriage and followed the caravan closely.
"Zutuliqi, do you know the unconscious guy?" Yan Tielong drove the carriage and asked Zituliqi in the carriage if he knew the young man who was knocked unconscious and tied up by him.
"I know! He is a bad guy!" Zituliqi admitted directly and said with a disgusted tone.
"Oh! Can you tell me what his name is and what he does in the Poisonous Wolf Gang?" Yan Tielong heard that he knew Qi Tuliqi and asked about the young man's affairs with some disgust.
"His name is Fuluo Tuen, and people in our circle like to call him Thorny Dog. He is the red card thug of Eagle Cuans, the most trusted dog-headed strategist of the Poison Wolf Gang.
Fulotun used to be a beggar like us. Before he joined the Lone Wolf Gang, he liked to make trouble and tease people. He was generally considered a good person. At that time, he would often fight with the bad guys who bullied us.
But things have changed since he joined the Poison Wolf Gang. As long as Yingcuans orders something, he will work hard to complete it, no matter whether it is right or wrong, and he will not miss the old feelings at all.
I used to see him severely injure his very close friend with his own hands. Later, I never saw his very close friend in Bostro Fortress. From then on, we all avoided him. "Zutuliqi introduced Fuluo Tuen's character and some past events with a somewhat complicated expression.
"It seems that something happened between this young man named Fulotun and Yingkuansi? That made Fulotun so loyal to Yingkuansi." Yan Tielong guessed after hearing the deeds of Fuluotun towards Fulotun.
"Brother, we think so too. People have inquired about Fulotun and Yingkuansi's self-construction in the past, but unfortunately there was no result." Qituliqi said helplessly.
"Haha, this is interesting. I want to see Ospine and how he made Fulotun abandon evil and do good. Now that I think about it, it's really exciting." Yan Tielong thought happily in his heart, and then he drove the carriage seriously.
The next night, the Platinum Eagle Banner South Caravan and Yan Tielong's carriage arrived at Guyu Town safely and without any danger. In a few days, they did not encounter any greenskins or criminals.
At the entrance of Lu Yuqian's tavern, Kemidis was waiting for the arrival of Yan Tielong and others. He looked at the intact Mulu beast convoy and asked Yan Tielong who was sitting on the carriage: "Tielong, nothing happened during this escort mission?".
"A lot of things happened during this escort mission, but nothing happened to the caravan." Yan Tielong responded.
"Oh, what are you waiting for? Come and have a few drinks with me and tell me what happened?" Kermidis said with interest when he heard Yan Tielong's words.
"Sorry, Uncle Kemedis, I have prepared some things and have to go somewhere.
As for what happened during this escort mission, wait until tomorrow or let Platinum Eagle Qinan tell you. What do you think? "Yan Tielong apologized to Kemedis and suggested.
"Well~, so that's it. Well, Tielong, say hello to that lady for me." Kemidis suddenly realized when he heard Yan Tielong's words and saw Yan Tielong's carriage.
"Okay, Uncle Kemedis, I understand." Yan Tielong nodded in response.
Yan Tielong said to Ospine who got off the Muru beast cart: "Ospine, come up, I will take you to see the lady I talked about last time.".
When Ospine heard that Yan Tielong was going to introduce the lady who made him feel perfect last time, he agreed: "Captain Yan Tielong, okay, I'll come up.".
After Yan Tielong got on the carriage in Ospine, he drove the carriage to another place.
"Hey~! We're here, Lutuliqi, Lutulixue, and Ospine, you can get off the car." YanTie Long drove the carriage to a small Western church that was a little old and simple. He turned around and said to the people in the carriage.
"Yes, it's Brother Tielong!" "Mom Pastor, come out quickly! Brother Tielong is back!" A six or seven-year-old boy wearing a patchwork cloth walked out of the small church. He was holding a broom and was about to sweep the road in front of the church. When he saw Yan Tielong on the carriage, he was surprised, and then turned around and ran into the church with the broom. He shouted in an excited voice.
"Captain Yan Tielong, where is this place?" Ospine asked the chapel when he saw Yan Tielong taking the two sisters, Litu, out of the carriage.
"Oh, this is Siyuli Life Church. It is said that this church is as old as Guyu Town and is the only church in the town." Yan Tielong introduced to Ospine and the two sisters Lutu beside him.
"Brother Tielong" "Brother Tielong, I miss you so much!". Just as Yan Tielong finished his introduction, eight or nine little lolita and little carrot heads of different sizes wearing patches ran out of the Life Church. They shouted Yan Tielong's name excitedly as they ran.
"Haha, little bear bag, you have grown up and become heavier." Yan Tielong picked up the first boy who came to him, about seven years old and wearing a cloth with six large patches, and smiled.
"Brother Tielong, I want a hug." A six-year-old girl with a double-tail braid stretched out her hands.
